A részekre bontás nem eredményezne egymástól ténylegesen független munkafolyamatokat, hanem olyan egymással szorosan együttműködő szerződéses teljesítéseket hozna létre, amelyek térbeli és időbeli koordinációja, ütemezése – az ajánlattételi szakaszban kiadandó ütemtervvel összhangban – többlet erőforrást, folyamatosan fokozott Megrendelői és Vállalkozói kontrollt, illetve többlet organizációt igényelne, melynek költségvonzatai drágítják a beruházás megvalósítását és jelentős interfészkockázatot eredményeznek. Die Angebotsabgabe ist für ein bis alle Lose möglich. Für Los 3 und Los 4 ist die Angebotsabgabe nur in Kombination möglich. Los 4 umfasst (Schul-)Standorte der GMH, die im Jahr 2029 zu prüfen sind. title: DigiAssist - Digitale Assistenzsysteme und Schulungen in einer WfbM
description: Mithilfe barrierefreier, visuell geführter und individuell anpassbarer Assistenzsysteme sollen Arbeitsabläufe für Menschen mit Behinderungen verständlich, nachvollziehbar und möglichst selbstständig ausführbar gestaltet werden. Dafür sollen an sechs Arbeitsplätzen digitale Lösungen eingesetzt werden und insbesondere Bild-, Video- und Gebärdenanleitungen, Pick-by-Light-Technologien sowie kameragestützte Qualitäts- und Fehlerkontrollen umfassen. Ziel ist es, Arbeitsprozesse zu unterstützen, Fehlerquoten zu reduzieren und die Teilhabe am Arbeitsleben zu stärken. Die Klientinnen und Klienten sollen aktiv in die Entwicklung, Erprobung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Systeme einbezogen werden. Das Vorhaben umfasst die Beschaffung und Implementierung der erforderlichen Hard- und Software, die Erstellung digitaler Arbeitsanleitungen, die Durchführung von Schulungen für Fachkräfte sowie Klientinnen und Klienten, die Pilotierung der Lösungen und den anschließenden Rollout auf weitere Arbeitsbereiche. Darüber hinaus sollen begleitende Evaluations- und Qualitätssicherungsmaßnahmen durchgeführt sowie ein Leitfaden zur nachhaltigen Nutzung der entwickelten Lösungen erstellt werden. Ziel des Vorhabens ist der Aufbau digitaler Kompetenzen, die Förderung von Selbstständigkeit und Arbeitsmotivation sowie die Verbesserung von Inklusion, Chancengleichheit und gesellschaftlicher Teilhabe sein. Das Vorhaben ist als Teilhabe- und Inklusionsprojekt auszurichten, bei dem digitale Technologien gezielt eingesetzt werden, um Menschen mit Behinderungen verbesserte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und ein höheres Maß an Selbstbestimmung im Arbeitsalltag zu ermöglichen.

title: Skadedyrkontroll og bekjempelse - Rammeavtale
description: Bakgrunn Tønsberg kommune har et løpende behov for tjenester og materiell knyttet til kontroll, forebygging og bekjempelse av skadedyr i kommunens bygningsmasse og tilknyttede anlegg. Eksisterende avtale utløper, og kommunen har behov for å etablere en ny rammeavtale som sikrer fortsatt trygg, effektiv og forutsigbar oppfølging i avtaleperioden. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å dekke kommunens behov for både planlagte og akutte tjenester innen skadedyrkontroll, samtidig som kommunen får én samlet og oversiktlig avtale for området. Rammeavtalen skal bidra til tidlig avdekking av skadedyr, redusere risiko for følgeskader, styrke helse, miljø og sikkerhet, og legge til rette for lik praksis og kvalitet på tvers av kommunens bygg og anlegg. Kommunen legger vekt på et langsiktig samarbeid med en leverandør som kan tilby faglig rådgivning, god dokumentasjon og tett oppfølging av oppdragene. Det er også viktig at leveransen understøtter kommunens mål om effektiv ressursbruk, god kontraktsoppfølging samt klima- og miljøhensyn i gjennomføringen av tjenestene. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder en rammeavtale med én leverandør for levering av tjenester og tilhørende materiell innen kontroll og bekjempelse av skadedyr. Avtalen skal omfatte både forebyggende arbeid, periodisk kontroll og akutte utrykninger ved behov. Leveransen skal dekke kommunens behov i kommunale bygg samt relevante uteområder og tekniske infrastrukturer, herunder blant annet vei, vann og avløp. Oppdraget omfatter skadedyrkontroll både innendørs og utendørs, inkludert håndtering av skadedyr i kjøkkenområder og andre sårbare lokasjoner. Ytelsen skal i hovedsak omfatte inspeksjon, vurdering av omfang og årsak, gjennomføring av nødvendige tiltak, bruk og levering av nødvendig materiell som feller og åtestasjoner, samt skriftlig rapportering for hvert oppdrag. Leverandøren skal også kunne gi anbefalinger om forebyggende tiltak og bidra til bedre oversikt, sporbarhet og historikk per bygg eller anlegg. Oppdraget vil kunne omfatte bekjempelse av ulike typer skadedyr, herunder blant annet rotter, mus, veggedyr, kakerlakker, sølvkre og skjeggkre, maur, møll og andre relevante insekter. Omfanget i avtaleperioden kan variere, og oppgitt volum er kun et estimat basert på tidligere forbruk. Leveransen skal derfor være skalerbar og tilpasses kommunens faktiske behov gjennom kontraktsperioden.

title: Maler- og beleggstjenester
description: Bakgrunn Tønsberg kommune har behov for å etablere en ny rammeavtale for maler- og beleggstjenester fordi eksisterende avtale er utløpt og må erstattes. Anskaffelsen skal sikre at kommunen fortsatt har tilgang til nødvendige tjenester for løpende vedlikehold og planlagte oppgraderinger i kommunens bygg og anlegg. Kommunen har et vedvarende og økende behov for utvendig og innvendig overflatebehandling i blant annet skoler, barnehager, helsebygg og øvrige formålsbygg. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å sikre riktig kvalitet, forutsigbar levering og effektiv oppfølging av oppdrag på tvers av virksomhetene. Rammeavtalen skal bidra til god ressursbruk, tydelige avropsrutiner og stabil leveranseevne gjennom hele avtaleperioden. Det tas sikte på en parallell modell med to leverandører, der oppdrag som hovedregel tilbys leverandøren rangert som nummer én, og deretter leverandøren rangert som nummer to dersom den første ikke kan levere innen fastsatte frister. Estimert samlet verdi er ca. kroner 35 000 000 ekskl. mva. over fire år. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Anskaffelsen gjelder en rammeavtale for levering av maler- og beleggstjenester til Tønsberg kommune. Leveransen skal dekke kommunens behov for arbeid knyttet til maling, gulvbelegg og annen overflatebehandling, både innendørs og utendørs. Rammeavtalen skal omfatte både løpende vedlikehold, mindre reparasjoner og planlagte oppussingsarbeider i kommunale bygg og anlegg. Oppdragene vil kunne variere i størrelse og kompleksitet, og vil blant annet gjelde arbeid i skoler, barnehager, helsebygg og andre bygg i daglig bruk. Det legges vekt på at avrop under rammeavtalen skal kunne gjennomføres effektivt og forutsigbart, med rask respons, god koordinering mot kommunens enheter og lik kvalitet i leveransene uavhengig av hvilken leverandør som utfører oppdraget. Leveransen skal også understøtte behovet for god dokumentasjon, herunder statusrapportering og oppdragsrelatert dokumentasjon. Arbeidene skal kunne utføres på en måte som ivaretar sikker drift og begrenser ulemper for brukere av byggene. Dette er særlig viktig i bygg med sårbare brukergrupper og høy aktivitet, som skoler, barnehager og helsebygg.

title: Anskaffelse av avisdistribusjon
description: Konkurransen gjelder avtaler om plikt til å levere aviser i abonnement på steder uten annen avisdistribusjon, i henhold til lov om posttjenester av 4. september 2015 nr. 91 («Postloven») §§ 6 og 7 annet ledd, jf. forskrift om post av 18. september 2015 nr. 1063 («Postforskriften») § 19. Tjenesten karakteriseres som en tjeneste av allmenn økonomisk betydning. Innkjøpet gjennomføres i tråd med EØS-avtalens regler om offentlig støtte og de såkalte Altmark-kriteriene. Samferdselsdepartementet («Oppdragsgiver») skal anskaffe avisdistribusjon på tre faste ukedager (tirsdager, torsdager og fredager). Det skal leveres slike tjenester i det geografiske området angitt i Kravspesifikasjonene i Vedlegg 1.3 og 2.3 - Punkt 3 («Det Geografiske Området»). Det Geografiske Området er inndelt i to leveringsområder, leveringsområde B som utgjør delkontrakt 1 og leveringsområde C som utgjør delkontrakt 2. Vedlegg A utgjør det samlede dekningsområdet for delkontrakt 1 og 2. Dermed vil Oppdragsgiver inngå to avtaler totalt sett. Leverandøren kan levere tilbud på delkontrakter i begge leveringsområdene, men det må være separate tilbud, jf. punkt 1.4 i konkurransegrunnlaget.

title: Anskaffelse av SDU og jumper for LoVe prosjektet
description: Oppdragsgiver ønsker å anskaffe en Subsea Distribution Unit (SDU) og jumper for LoVe prosjektet. (se vedlagte konkurransegrunnlag for mer utfyllende informasjon. ) Denne anskaffelsen omfatter en SDU (Subsea Distribution Unit) og en jumper med en levetid på 20 år. De skal ha en dybderate på 1000 m. SDU SDU skal bestå av wet-mate mottakere for tilkobling til plugg (3 kVAC) og 8-fibers plugg på inngangssiden. På utgangssiden skal SDU ha 3 stk. wet-mate elektriske mottakere (230 VAC) og 3 stk. wet-mate optiske mottakere, hvorav 2 fibre for hver optisk mottaker. SDU har også en nedtransformator (step-down trafo) som konverterer 3 kVAC til 230 VAC. Trafo skal være plassert i et oljefylt (trykkbalansert) hus, med redundans. Installasjon av SDU skal ikke være avhengig av jumper. Oppdragsgiver ønsker at eksisterende SDU-struktur skal inspiseres og gjenbrukes i størst mulig grad (se figur 3). Den skal modifiseres uten tap av levetid på 20 år, etter godkjenning fra Oppdragsgiver. Sertifisering av løftepunkter kreves. Jumper Jumperens omfang skal inkludere offshorearbeid med nødvendige deler og materialer for å skjøte jumperen på kabel-enden ved P1 i figur 1. Offshorearbeidet skal utføres etter avtale med Oppdragsgiver. Når SDU er satt ut på havbunnen nær posisjon P1, skal jumper kobles til SDU. Jumper består av en 4-pinners wet-mate elektrisk konnektor (3 kVAC plugg) og en 8-fibers wet-mate optisk konnektor (plugg) (design vist i figur 2). Jumper skal festes til SDU, og slangen skal være oljefylt og lang nok til å kobles til SDUs mottakere. Oppdragsgiver ønsker at eksisterende jumper-struktur skal inspiseres og gjenbrukes i størst mulig grad (se figur 2). Den skal modifiseres uten tap av levetid på 20 år, etter godkjenning fra Oppdragsgiver.

title: Anskaffelse av konsulenttjenester for atomsikkerhet, inkludert håndtering av brukt brensel, strålevern og risikovurdering
description: Konsulentavtalen skal omfatte levering av tekniske tjenester til støtte for DSAs kjernefunksjoner innen regulatorisk arbeid. Arbeidet skal omfatte gjennomgang og vurdering av teknisk dokumentasjon og støtte til DSA i forbindelse med inspeksjoner.Det finnes tre kjernekraftanlegg i Norge: forskningsreaktoranleggene på Kjeller og i Halden, og det kombinerte deponiet og lagringsanlegget for lav- og middels radioaktivt avfall i Himdalen. I 2018 etablerte den norske regjeringen en ny statlig organisasjon, Norsk Nukleærdekommisjonering (NND), som vil overta alle norske kjernekraftanlegg på Kjeller, Halden og Himdalen fra den opprinnelige operatøren, Institutt for Energiteknikk (IFE). NND vil være ansvarlig for driften av kjernekraftanleggene, avviklingen av dem og håndteringen av radioaktivt avfall og brukt kjernebrensel. Så langt er kjernekraftanlegget i Halden overført fra IFE til NND, og de to andre anleggene er nær ved å bli overført.Før avviklingen kan starte, er det en rekke prosesser som må fullføres for at operatøren(e) skal være i stand til å gjøre endringer i anleggene på en sikker og ansvarlig måte, og for at reguleringsmyndigheten (DSA) skal være i stand til å godkjenne endringer i samsvar med forskrifter og internasjonale standarder. Som forberedelse til avvikling og under avviklingen vil det være behov for å etablere nye avfallshåndteringsanlegg, inkludert planer for et amerikanskutviklet mobilt smeltekonsolideringsanlegg (MMC).Anskaffelsen omfattes av sikkerhetsloven og gjenspeiles i oppdragsgivers kravspesifikasjon og krav til sikkerhet. Leverandører som ønsker å tilby i denne anskaffelsen, bes særskilt om å sette seg inn i angitte retningslinjer, forutsetninger og krav.

title: Germany – Electricity distribution – Luftgestützte Durchführung von Thermografiemessungen und deren Auswertung im Leitungsnetz der Tennet TSO GmbH 2027 - 2028
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die luftgestützte, thermografische Untersuchung von insgesamt 11.209 Freileitungskilometern auf 110-, 220- und 380-kV-Ebene im Netzgebiet der TenneT TSO GmbH sowie die anschließende Auswertung der Aufnahmen und die Übergabe der Ergebnisse. Die thermografischen Befliegungen sind mittels Luftfahrzeug (bspw. Hubschrauber) durchzuführen. Insbesondere müssen: - große Leitungslängen innerhalb kurzer geeigneter Wetter- und Lastfenster abgearbeitet werden, - eine sichere Befliegung von 110-/220-/380-kV-Freileitungen bei gleichzeitigem Einhalten der erforderlichen Flugprofile gewährleistet werden, - eine ausreichende Reichweite, Flugzeit und Einsatzflexibilität für großräumige Leitungsabschnitte sichergestellt werden, - der Betrieb der Thermografiesysteme ermöglicht werden, - kurzfristige Dispositionen in Abhängigkeit von Netzbetrieb, Wetterlage und Strombelastung umgesetzt werden können. Die Leistungserbringung erfolgt gemäß der Ausschreibungsunterlagen, insbesondere gemäß der "TenneT Richtlinie Thermografie". Die Leistungen werden ausgeschrieben für die Befliegungszeiträume 2027 und 2028. Die ausgeschriebenen Leistungen werden dabei auf folgende drei Lose aufgeteilt: - Los 1: 3.029 Freileitungskilometer (Leitungsbereich: Bayern_Süd & Franken) - Los 2: 3.918 Freileitungskilometer (Leitungsbereich: Hessen & Niedersachsen_Ost) - Los 3: 4.262 Freileitungskilometer (Leitungsbereich: Niedersachsen_West & Schleswig-Holstein) Achtung: Die angegebenen Leitungs-/Stromkreislängen entsprechen dem Bestand im jeweiligen Los. Es wäre wünschenswert, die komplette Länge zu thermografieren. Die Erfahrung hat jedoch gezeigt, dass auf Grund von schlechtem Wetter, fehlender Auslastung oder anderen Netzsituationen tatsächlich nur eine geringere Leitungslänge thermografiert werden kann. Ziel der Thermografiemessungen ist es, mindestens 70 % der Leitungs-/Stromkreislängen zu erreichen. Einen groben Überblick verschafft die in den Ausschreibungsunterlagen beiliegende Netzkarte. Anbieter können sich auf einzelne oder (vorzugsweise) auf alle Lose bewerben. Die maximale Anzahl an Losen, die an einen Bieter vergeben werden können, ist begrenzt auf zwei Lose. Einschränkend ist zu beachten, dass der Zuschlag für ein Los nur erfolgen kann, wenn für das entsprechende Los ein komplettes Team mit Equipment (Personal, Luftfahrzeug, Messsystem) zur Verfügung steht (für zwei Lose also zwei unterschiedliche Teams). Ein Paketnachlass bei Vergabe von zwei Losen ist möglich und gerne gesehen. Die Vergabe erfolgt unter dem Gesichtspunkt der Gesamtwirtschaftlichkeit. title: Norway – Electrical circuit components – Procurement of SDU and jumper for the LoVe project
description: The contracting authority would like to procure a Subsea Distribution Unit (SDU) and jumper for the LoVe project. (See the attached tender documentation for more detailed information. ) This procurement is for an SDU (Subsea Distribution Unit) and a jumper with a lifetime of 20 years. They shall have a depth rate of 1000 m. SDU SDU shall consist of wet-feed receivers for connecting to plug (3 kVAC) and 8-fibre plug on the entrance side. On the output side, SDU shall have 3 wet-feed electrical receivers (230 VAC) and 3 wet-feed optical receivers, of which 2 fibres for each optical receiver. SDU also has a step-down transformer that converts 3 kVAC to 230 VAC. The transformer shall be placed in an oil filled (pressure balanced) house, with redundancy. The installation of SDU shall not depend on jumpers. The contracting authority would like the existing SDU structure to be inspected and reused to the greatest possible degree (see Figure 3). It shall be modified without a loss of lifetime of 20 years, subsequent to approval by the Contracting Authority. Certification of lifting points is required. Jumper The extent of the jumper shall include offshore work with the necessary parts and materials to join the jumper on the cable end at P1 in Figure 1. The offshore work shall be carried out in accordance with agreement with the Contracting Authority. When the SDU is out on the seabed near position P1, the jumper shall be connected to the SDU. The jumper consists of a 4-pin wet-feed electrical connector (3 kVAC plug) and an 8-fibre wet-feed optical connector (plug) (design shown in Figure 2). The jumper shall be attached to the SDU and the hose shall be oil filled and long enough to be connected to the centraldu's receivers. The contracting authority would like the existing jumper structure to be inspected and reused to the greatest possible degree (see Figure 2). It shall be modified without a loss of lifetime of 20 years, subsequent to approval by the Contracting Authority.

title: Datalähtöisen ja AI-avusteisen asiakasohjauksen kehittämiskumppanuus
description: Datalähtöisen ja AI-avusteisen asiakasohjauksen kehittämiskumppanuus HANKINNAN TAUSTA Strateginen suunta kohti vuotta 2030 Business Finlandin Strategia 2030:n keskeisenä tavoitteena on saavuttaa julkishallinnon paras asiakaskokemus sekä kasvattaa Business Finlandin vaikuttavuutta suomalaisen elinkeinoelämän uudistumisessa, kasvussa ja kansainvälistymisessä. Tavoitteen saavuttaminen edellyttää siirtymistä nykyisistä osittain manuaalisista, reaktiivisista ja asiantuntijariippuvaisista toimintamalleista kohti tietojohtoista, ennakoivaa ja skaalautuvaa asiakasohjausta. Digitalisaation tavoitteena ei ole yksinomaan järjestelmien kehittäminen tai teknologian käyttöönotto, vaan toimintatapojen, prosessien ja kyvykkyyksien kokonaisvaltainen uudistaminen. Business Finland haluaa hyödyntää dataa, analytiikkaa ja tekoälyä asiakkaidensa tunnistamisessa, ohjaamisessa ja palvelemisessa sekä vapauttaa asiantuntijoidensa aikaa tausta- tai rutiinitehtävistä vaikuttavampaan asiakastyöhön. Samanaikaisesti tavoitteena on vahvistaa asiakkaiden kuuntelemista ja asiakasymmärryksen hyödyntämistä osana palveluiden, toimintamallien ja asiakkuuksien kehittämistä. Asiakaskokemusta, asiakasohjauksen vaikuttavuutta sekä palveluiden käyttöä seurataan ja mitataan systemaattisesti, jotta toimintaa voidaan jatkuvasti kehittää tiedolla johdetusti. Transformaation onnistumista arvioidaan muun muassa seuraavilla mittareilla: • asiakaskokemus ja asiakkaiden suosittelu • asiakasohjauksen osuvuus • palveluihin ohjautuminen • palveluiden käyttöaste • asiakastarpeiden tunnistamisen onnistuminen • asiakasaktivoinnin vaikuttavuus • asiakkuuksien kehitys ja palveluiden hyödyntäminen • asiantuntijatyön tehokkuus ja automaation hyödyntäminen • datan, analytiikan ja tekoälyn hyödyntämisen aste • Business Finlandin strategisten tavoitteiden toteutumista tukevat vaikuttavuusmittarit. Nykytilan haasteet ja tarve muutokselle Business Finland on toteuttanut datalla johdetun asiakasohjauksen esiselvityksen, jonka yhteydessä on tunnistettu useita nykytilan kehityskohteita ja pullonkauloja. Näiden ratkaisemiseksi tarvitaan pitkäjänteinen kehittämiskumppani tukemaan organisaation muutosta. Keskeiset tunnistetut haasteet ovat: 1. Tiedon hajanaisuus ja rajallinen asiakasymmärrys: Asiakkaisiin, markkinoihin, palveluihin, asiointiin, vuorovaikutukseen ja verkostoihin liittyvä tieto on hajautunut useisiin järjestelmiin, tietovarantoihin ja ulkoisiin tietolähteisiin. Tämän vuoksi organisaatiolla ei ole yhtenäistä ja ajantasaista näkymää asiakkaisiin, asiakkaiden tarpeisiin, potentiaaliin, palveluiden käyttöön, asiointihistoriaan eikä asiakkuuden nykytilaan. Tämä vaikeuttaa asiakkaiden tunnistamista, kohdentamista, priorisointia sekä oikea-aikaista palveluohjausta. 2. Proaktiivisuuden puute ja AI-avusteisen asiakasohjauksen rajallinen hyödyntäminen: Business Finlandilta puuttuu systemaattinen kyvykkyys tunnistaa, priorisoida ja ohjata oikeat asiakkaat oikeisiin palveluihin oikeaan aikaan. AI-avusteisen analytiikan, kohdentamisen ja palveluohjauksen hyödyntäminen on vielä rajallista, mikä heikentää asiakasohjauksen vaikuttavuutta ja skaalautuvuutta. 3. Manuaalinen asiakasohjaus ja asiantuntijoiden tunnistaminen: Asiakkaiden tarpeiden yhdistäminen oikeisiin palveluihin, asiantuntijoihin, verkostoihin ja ekosysteemeihin perustuu nykyisin pitkälti manuaaliseen tiedonhakuun ja yksittäisten asiantuntijoiden kokemukseen. Organisaatiolta puuttuu AI-avusteinen kyvykkyys tunnistaa asiakkaan tilanteeseen parhaiten soveltuvat palvelut, asiantuntijat ja yhteistyömahdollisuudet sekä tukea asiantuntijoita oikea-aikaisilla suosituksilla. Tämä hidastaa palveluprosessia, vaikeuttaa tiedon hyödyntämistä ja heikentää asiakasohjauksen skaalautuvuutta. Tavoitetila: Datalla johdetun ja AI-avusteisen asiakasohjauksen malli Pitkän aikavälin visiona on rakentaa yhtenäiseen asiakaskuvaan, datalähtöiseen päätöksentekoon, tekoälyavusteiseen asiakasohjaukseen sekä moderniin data- ja AI-kyvykkyyteen perustuva toimintamalli. Tavoitteena on muodostaa kokonaisvaltainen näkymä asiakkaisiin, heidän tarpeisiinsa, potentiaaliinsa, asiointiinsa ja palveluiden käyttöön sekä hyödyntää tätä tietoa asiakkaiden tunnistamisessa, ohjaamisessa ja kehittämisessä. Tavoitetilassa asiakkaan polku jakautuu kolmeen vaiheeseen, joiden digitaalista kyvykkyyttä Toimittajan tulee tukea kehittämään: 1. Tunnista & tavoita Hyödynnämme sisäisiä ja ulkoisia tietolähteitä tunnistaaksemme uusia potentiaalisia kasvuyrityksiä sekä ennakoidaksemme asiakkaiden tarpeita. Asiakkaille kohdennetaan oikea-aikaisesti heidän tilanteeseensa sopivia palveluita, sisältöjä, tapahtumia ja yhteydenottoja datan, analytiikan ja AI-avusteisen kohdentamisen avulla. 2. Palvele & ratkaise Autamme asiakkaita löytämään heidän tilanteeseensa parhaiten soveltuvat palvelut, rahoitusinstrumentit, asiantuntijat, verkostot ja kansainvälistymismahdollisuudet. AI-avusteinen asiakasohjaus tukee tarpeiden tunnistamista, asiantuntijoiden työtä, palveluiden suosittelua sekä asiakkaiden ohjautumista tarkoituksenmukaisiin palvelupolkuihin. 3. Seuraa & syvennä Hyödynnämme tietoa asiakkaiden kehityksestä, palveluiden käytöstä ja asiointihistoriasta asiakkuuksien jatkuvaan kehittämiseen. Ennakoimme asiakkaiden tulevia tarpeita ja suosittelemme proaktiivisesti seuraavia palveluita, verkostoja, ohjelmia ja kehittämispolkuja asiakkaan kasvun, kansainvälistymisen ja vaikuttavuuden tukemiseksi. Tämän vuoksi Business Finland etsii kumppania, joka ei ainoastaan toimita teknistä koodia tai arkkitehtuurikuvauksia, vaan kykenee viemään muutoksen läpi kaikilla tasoilla: luomassa arvoa tuottavia käyttötapauksia, rakentamassa vankkaa kyvykkyysperustaa, uudistamassa organisaation yhteistä kieltä ja operointimallia sekä johtamassa kulttuurista muutosta ja asiantuntijoiden datalukutaitoa.,

description: Aviapoliksen lukion ateria- ja puhtauspalveluiden hankinta Hankinnan kohteena on ateria- ja puhtauspalveluiden hankinta Vantaan kaupungin Aviapoliksen lukiolle tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Aviapoliksen lukio otetaan käyttöön asteittain. Alkuvaiheessa vuonna 2027 opiskelijoita arvioidaan olevan 90 opiskelijaa. Henkilökuntaa arvioidaan olevan alkuvaiheessa noin 2-15 henkilöä. Vuonna 2028 oppilasmäärän arvioidaan olevan noin 530 ja henkilökuntaa noin 15-20 henkilöä ja vuonna 2029 oppilasmäärä on arviolta 700 oppilasta. Vuoden 2029 tarkkaa henkilökuntamäärää ei vielä ole tiedossa. Tilaaja valitsee enintään yhden (1) sopimustoimittajan. Sopimus tehdään toistaiseksi voimassa olevaksi. Sopimuksen ehdot on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteenä olevissa sopimusluonnoksissa (liite 1 ja 2). Sopimuskauden arvioitu alkamisajankohta on 1.1.2027. Tilaaja ei sitoudu tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa arvioituihin hankintamääriin tai euromääräisiin arvoihin sopimuskaudella. Tarjoajien tarjouksien määrittelemisen helpottamiseksi, Tilaaja järjestää kohteeseen yhteisnäyttöpäivän. Tarjoajien on osallistuttava yhteisnäyttöpäivään, ennen tarjouksen jättämistä. Tarjouspyynnön kohteena olevat tilat ateria- ja puhtauspalveluiden osalta esitellään seuraavasti: Aviapoliksen lukio, 26.10.2026 klo 9.00 Kohteen tilojen esittelytilaisuuksiin tulee ilmoittautua viimeistään 23.10.2026 klo 16.00 mennessä sähköpostitse osoitteeseen ostoyksikko.puhtauspalvelut@vantaa.fi. Tarjoajien tasapuolisen ja syrjimättömän kohtelun vuoksi tarjoajien kohteissa esittämiin kysymyksiin ei vastata. Kaikki yhteisnäyttökierroksilla esiin tulleet kysymykset tulee esittää tarjouspalvelu.fi:n kautta, jonka kautta annetaan myös vastaukset tulleisiin kysymyksiin. Tarjoajan tulee todistaa henkilöllisyys osallistuessaan yhteisnäyttöön. Lisätietoja yhteisnäyttöpäivästä löytyy kohdasta Hankinnan kohteen kriteerit.,

description: Forsvarsmateriell (FMA) har tre hovedoppgaver: å anskaffe, forvalte og utfase materiell for Forsvaret og øvrige virksomheter i forsvarssektoren. Målet er å gi Forsvaret raskere reaksjonsevne, høyere beredskap og lengere utholdenhet. FMA Anskaffelser inngår, forvalter, gjør avrop på rammeavtaler og inngår kontrakter på/anskaffer materiell i henhold til lov og forskrift om offentlige anskaffelser (LOA/FOA/FOSA) samt interne instrukser. Formålet med anskaffelsen er å inngå avtale med leverandører som kan bistå oppdragsgiver med gjennomføringen av anskaffelser. Bistanden skal dekke alle deler av anskaffelsesprosessen, herunder planlegging utarbeidelse av konkurransegrunnlag, gjennomføring av konkurranse, evaluering av tilbud, samt kontraktsinngåelse og for enkelte kategorier; kontraktsoppfølging. Det vises til SSA-B bilag 1 for nærmere angivelse av de ulike kategorienes omfang.

France – Feasibility study, advisory service, analysis – Caractérisation géotechnique du ballast
description: Dans le cadre des opérations de renouvellement de la voie ferrée, SNCF Réseau souhaite caractériser le complexe ballasté dégarni. En effet, des prélèvements en voie du ballast en vue d’une analyse de la forme géotechnique (forme du grain, dureté) sont nécessaires dans le cadre des études préliminaires des chantiers à venir. Cette prestation s’inscrit dans le projet stratégique SNCF Réseau, de valorisation des sous-produits ferroviaires et de développement du réemploi du ballast. En particulier, le cahier des charges décrit les prestations à réaliser afin d’effectuer des prélèvements des échantillons de ballast en voie et des analyses géotechniques en laboratoire, en vue de définir les conditions de réutilisation/réemploi avant réalisation de travaux. L’objectif est d’obtenir les informations suivantes sur le ballast en voie, à renouveler : -L’état de vieillissement -Les performances intrinsèques -La qualité globale La prestation à assurer est divisé en quatre missions. Ces prestations peuvent être de différentes natures et commandées indépendamment les unes aux autres : - Mission 1 : Définition du programme de prélèvement en fonction des informations transmises par le demandeur (et élaboration du devis). - Mission 2 : Réalisation des prélèvements et remise en état - Mission 3 : Conditionnement des échantillons et réalisation des analyses en laboratoire - Mission 4 : Livrables Les sites à étudier sont en exploitation ferroviaire. Le marché est alloti en 4 lots géographiques, et se présente sous forme d'un accord-cadre à bons de commande (multi-attributaires pour chaque lot). Chaque lot est conclu pour une durée ferme de 24 mois.

description: Requirement includes a wide variety of non-merchantable vegetation management activities for the purpose of fuels reduction, prescribed burn unit preparation, stand improvement, or unit rehabilitation. Activities could include, but are not limited to, tree thinning, slashing, girdling, pruning, weed and release, release of browse species, slash treatment, hand piling, fuel break construction, Fireline construction, residual tree protection, duff mound removal, unit preparation work, rehabilitation, chipping and related services. Unit boundary/special protection area designation and/or traversing for or within these units may also be included in the activity.

JOHN DAY DAM NAVIGATION LOCK TAINTER VALVE (TV) REPAIRS TV3 AND TV4
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineer (USACE) Portland District is soliciting construction firms who are interested in submitting a competitive firm-fixed-price bid for this project. This solicitation announcement is for the repair and rehabilitation of two Tainter Valves (TV3 and TV4) at the John Day Lock and Dam (JDA). See the attached Solicitation, which includes the Specifications, and the attached Planset for all details. Because a similar requirement at The Dalles Lock and Dam will be solicited after this solicitation, the Government will host the following two site visits on Wednesday, 28 October 2026: 9:00 A.M. @ John Day Dam, Exit 109 from I-84, John Day Dam Rd, Rufus, OR 97050. 2:00 P.M. @ The Dalles Dam, Exit 88 from I-84, The Dalles Dam Rd, The Dalles, OR 97058. Contractors will be able to see a removed Tainter Valve at The Dalles Dam. Send an email to Andrew Sprys and Justin Figueredo by 11:00 A.M. on Friday, 23 October 2026, with the following information to register for the site visit: Solicitation Number: W9127N27BA009, Project Title: JOHN DAY DAM NAVIGATION LOCK TAINTER VALVE (TV) REPAIRS TV3 AND TV4, Name(s) of individual(s) attending site visit, Name of Company, Phone Number, Email Address, Are all individuals U.S. Citizens? Participants of the scheduled site visit must abide by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Safety and Health Requirements Manual (EM 385-1-1, latest version) in accordance with Section 5, Personal Protective and Safety Equipment. It is the responsibility of the participants to wear personal protective and safety equipment as required by this regulation. Failure to comply could result in denial of access to site visit location. Site visit attendees must be U.S. citizens and possess a REAL ID to access the sites. Any subsequent visits will require prearrangement with the Contracting Division personnel listed above and may not be guaranteed/approved. Acceptable forms of proof of citizenship for anyone born outside the USA is: 1. US Birth Certificate: Must be certified and issued by either a US State or the US State Department. 2. US Passport Undamaged: Issued by the US Dept of State, without limitation, does not need to be current, is/was valid for 10 years for adults and 5 years for children under 16. 3. US Passport Card Undamaged: Issued by the US Dept of State, without limitation, does not need to be current. 4. US Certificate of Citizenship: Issued by US Citizenship and Immigration Service. 5. Consular Report of Birth Abroad: Issued by the US State Department. 6. US Naturalization Certificate: Issued by US Citizenship and Immigration Service. 7. Enhanced Drivers License: from Michigan, Minnesota, New York, Vermont, or Washington. Acceptable ID: 1. Real ID drivers license. 2. Enhanced drivers license. 3. Federal Identification Cards PIC/CAC/PIV/Etc. 4. Transportation Worker Identification Card (TWIC). 5. United States Passport or United States Passport Card. 6. Drivers license issued by the Department of State. Magnitude of Construction: The estimated cost of the project is between $1,000,000 to $5,000,000. Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) level: The CMMC level anticipated for this requirement is CMMC Level 1 (Self). This CMMC level, or higher (see 32 CFR part 170), will be required prior to award and maintained for the duration of the contract for each contractor information system that will process, store, or transmit Federal contract information (FCI) or controlled unclassified information (CUI) during performance of the contract. description: The K9 FY27 Timber Sale (Contract No. N40085-27-RP-00049) is located on Naval Weapons Station, Crane, Indiana, and consists of four (4) tracts totaling approximately 197 acres. Bids shall be prepared in accordance with the IFB and Standard Form 114 (Sale of Government Property -- Bid and Award). title: Trash removal services at Harrison Village, West Point, and Pittsburg commissaries.
description: Trash removal services at Harrison Village, West Point, and Pittsburg commissaries. Trash removal services include the collection, removal, transportation, and proper disposal of non-hazardous solid waste generated during daily operations. Services are performed on a scheduled basis or as needed to maintain clean, safe, and sanitary conditions. This includes emptying designated trash receptacles, replacing liners, transporting waste to approved collection or disposal areas, and ensuring compliance with all applicable environmental, safety, and facility regulations. All waste is handled and disposed of in accordance with the requirements of the Statement of Work (SOW) and applicable federal, state, and local regulations.

The contractor is not entitled to any equitable adjustment to the contract price or terms based on the Government's disapproval of a requested change to manuals, drawings, specifications, or to a repair source or facility. 3.4.2 References on Drawings and Specifications:For repair and overhaul purposes only. title: Electronic Safe and Arm Devices (ESAD)
description: The U.S Army Contracting Command-Rock Island at Picatinny, on behalf of the Department of War (DoW) Fuze Integrated Product Team (IPT) is seeking feedback from industry on Continental United States (CONUS) sources and information regarding the existing capability to manufacture Electronic Safe and Arm Devices (ESAD) fuzes for munitions, as well as Ignition Safety Devices (ISDs) for rocket motors. DISCLAIMER: THIS RFI IS FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY AND SHALL NOT BE CONSTRUED AS A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL, NOR AS AN OBLIGATION ON THE PART OF THE GOVERNMENT. THE GOVERNMENT DOES NOT INTEND TO AWARD A CONTRACT ON THE BASIS OF THIS RFI OR REIMBURSE ANY CONTRACTORS FOR ANY INFORMATION OR ADMINISTRATIVE COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH RESPONDING TO THIS NOTIFICATION. PARTICIPATION IN THIS EFFORT IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY AND ANY OF THE INFORMATION STATED ABOVE IS SUBJECT TO CHANGE. THE GOVERNMENT INTENDS TO USE THE INFORMATION RECEIVED TO DEVELOP A WHITEPAPER AND INVESTMENT STRATEGY TO SUPPORT THE SCALE-UP NECESSARY TO EXPAND AND SECURE THE DOMESTIC ELECTRONIC FUZING AND IGNITION SYSTEMS INDUSTRIAL BASE. THE GOVERNMENT RESERVES THE RIGHT TO USE ANY NON-PROPRIETARY INFORMATION IN ANY RESULTANT SOLICITATION(S). PROPRIETARY INFORMATION SHOULD BE MARKED AS SUCH. IF A FORMAL SOLICITATION IS GENERATED AT A LATER DATE, THE GOVERNMENT WILL PUBLISH A SOLICITATION NOTICE. DESCRIPTION: The Government is specifically seeking to understand the industrial base's capacity to scale production in response to emerging high-rate defense requirements. These include supporting Weaponized Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS) for Drone Dominance, Launched Effects (LE), Counter-UAS (cUAS) technologies, low-cost/high-rate systems, alongside the increased production demand for existing munition systems. To enable this scalability, the Government must identify critical manufacturing, testing, and component-level supply chain bottlenecks, specifically concerning high-voltage firing capacitors, solid-state high-voltage switches, and In-Line Initiators (ILI) to include Explosive Foil Initiators (EFIs) / Low Energy Exploding Foil Initiators (LEEFIs) / Exploding Foil Deflagrating Initiators (EFDIs). The PSC code is 1390 � Fuzes and Primers RESPONSE REQUIREMENTS: The U.S. Government is requesting information from all interested CONUS sources having relevant ESAD and ISD manufacturing, assembly, energetic loading/integration, and testing capabilities. Respondents shall describe their prior experience, existing facility capabilities, relevant equipment, and personnel. With respect to the Government�s interest in the above, to adequately assess capability, responses shall address the following specific requirements: Past Performance and Demonstrated Experience: Describe your company�s historical experience and proven capability in developing, manufacturing, assembling, and qualifying electronic fuzing systems (i.e. ESADs, ESAFs, etc.) and rocket motor ignition devices (ISDs, Arm & Fire Devices, etc.) over the past five (5) years. Specifically address: Deliveries and Programs: List specific types, nomenclatures, and physical form factors of ESADs and electronic ISDs delivered. Detail total annual quantities delivered, peak production rates achieved, and whether your company served as the Prime or Subcontractor. Manufacturing and Production Infrastructure: Describe demonstrated experience operating electronics manufacturing and assembly lines, including Surface Mount Technology (SMT), Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Assemblies, Electrostatic Discharge (ESD)-controlled cleanroom environments, and energetic integration bays. Qualification, Testing, and Compliance History: Detail past performance qualifying systems to military safety and performance standards. Identify major cost and schedule drivers, specifically contrasting automated versus manual testing procedures. Additionally, describe your environmental stress testing experience and how it aligns with the operational envelopes of low-cost platforms. Workforce Experience: Detail the baseline technical competencies and certifications (e.g., IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, energetic material handling) of your current workforce across touch labor, high-voltage analog electrical engineering, RF design, and test engineering. Future Capabilities, Surge Capacity, and Scalability: Detail your facility�s ability to scale manufacturing throughput, adopt automated production/inspection methods, expand engineering capacity, and overcome component supply bottlenecks to meet anticipated defense surge demands. Specifically address: Production Rates and Surge Capacity: State your facility's current minimum viable annual production rate (economic run rate) and absolute maximum surge capacity (assuming multi-shift operations). Provide a projected year-by-year production profile from Government Fiscal Year (GFY) October 2027 through GFY 2031, detailing ramp-up capacity to support: Weaponized UxS / Purpose Built Attritable Systems (PBAS) to support Drone Dominance Munitions Acceleration Council (MAC) requirements Launched Effects (LE), Counter-UAS (cUAS) interceptors, and other similar low-cost, high-rate systems. Component Supply Chain and Critical Bottlenecks: Identify lead times, cost drivers, sole/single-source dependencies, and/or End-of-Life (EOL)/Product Change Notices (PCN) across key ESAD/ISD component technologies such as High-Voltage Firing Capacitors, High-Voltage Switches, Explosive Foil Initiators (EFIs) / LEEFIs, Logic and Processing Devices (one-time programmable - OTP logic devices, microcontrollers, field-programmable gate arrays � FPGAs, etc. Detail mitigation strategies, domestic alternative sources, or government investments needed. Advanced Manufacturing, Automation, and Facility Expansion: Outline planned or required capital investments, facility expansions, or automated assembly cells needed to support high-rate surge. Detail current and planned implementations of flexible automation cells, automated in-line inspection (e.g., in-line digital X-ray, Automated Optical Inspection [AOI], 3D dimensioning), and automated fuze/tester architectures (e.g., high-throughput bench-level testing for safety critical functions). Workforce Recruitment and Scaling Plan: Provide an overview of recruitment, onboarding, and training roadmap to scale engineering and assembly labor for surge production. Include timed milestones, required training hours, measurable certification standards, and strategies to overcome regional labor shortages or cleared personnel constraints. Additionally, identify any systemic training shortcomings, instructional gaps, or critical hurdles to attracting and retaining qualified personnel for these specialized roles. Security, Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), and Classified Handling: Confirm your company�s capability to handle, store, transmit, and process Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), Controlled Technical Information (CTI), and classified material. Provide confirmation of compliance with relevant defense cybersecurity standards (e.g., NIST SP 800-171, CMMC requirements). SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: Interested vendors are strongly encouraged to submit a capabilities statement with the following information: NAICS: 332993 � Ammunition Manufacturing, 333249 � Other Industrial Machinery Manufacturing PSC: 1390 � Fuzes and Primers Responses shall be in PDF format and shall not exceed fifteen (15) pages, including the cover sheet, photos, and diagrams. The minimum acceptable font size is 12 Calibri. The cover sheet shall include the following company information: Response shall include documentation of technical expertise and capability in sufficient detail for the Government to adequately assess the capabilities of your company. It is imperative that business concerns responding to this Request for Information (RFI) articulate their capabilities clearly and adequately. title: UT NP ARCH 100(2) Bridges on Delicate Arch Road
description: PROJECT NUMBER: UT NP ARCH 100(2) PROJECT NAME: Bridges on Delicate Arch Road PROJECT DESCRIPTION: Delicate Arch Road (DAR) is within Arches National Park (Park) and provides access to Delicate Arch. DAR is a functional class 1 roadway (Principal Park Road) and is heavily traveled by visitors and often congested during periods with moderate-to-high levels of visitation. DAR crosses three low-gradient ephemeral washes (Salt Valley Wash, Salt Wash, and Winter Camp Wash) near their confluence in the Salt Wash Basin downstream of Wolfe Ranch. Culverts installed during original road construction in the mid-1990s and during subsequent upgrades are inadequate to allow unobstructed stream flow and sediment transport downstream. This existing condition produces flooding and sediment deposition, which creates unsafe conditions for visitors, triggers road closures, potentially strands Park visitors, diminishes visitor experience of the Park, and generates high operational costs associated with traffic management, visitor safety, and cleanup operations. SCOPE OF THE WORK: This project will be designated as Reconstruction (4R) with one segment of restoration (3R), and will design and construct 100� span concrete bridges at the Salt Valley Wash, Salt Wash, and Winter Camp Wash. The DA roadway profile at each Wash will be raised to accommodate a 10-year design frequency and allow a medium-sized excavator to access each wash. The DA will be realigned at the Salt Valley wash, moving the roadway and new bridge location to the north of the existing roadway and drainage crossing. The remaining 3R sections of the roadway will receive full depth reclamation (FDR) or removal of pavement, including all parking areas, followed by a 4-inch pavement overlay. title: Alaska Construction IDIQ Sources Sought
description: SOURCES SOUGHT Construction Services for General Services Administration (GSA), Public Buildings Service (PBS) in Alaska Sources Sought Response Date: November 19th, 2026 1:00 PM PT The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. This Sources Sought Notice is a market research tool being utilized to determine interest and capability of potential sources prior to issuing a formal solicitation, as the solicitation is not available at this time. This IS NOT a Request for Offerors or Proposals. This notice does not represent a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract, nor does it restrict the Government to a particular acquisition approach. This is a Sources Sought Announcement for planning purposes only. Market research is being conducted to determine if there are businesses with the requisite capabilities and experience to perform the required work. In addition, this market research is to determine if there are respondents that qualify under one or more socio-economic indicators, including but not limited to, small business, woman-owned business, Women Owned Small business (WOSB), Economically Disadvantaged Women Owned Small business (EDWOSB), Veteran Owned Small business, Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small business, SBA Certified Small Disadvantaged business, SBA Certified 8(a) Firm, SBA Certified HUBZone Firm. The U.S. General Services Administration (GSA) anticipates procuring the services of multiple contractors to perform Construction Services in the nature of repair and alteration of real property. The nature of the service is to support the government to successfully accomplish the small project repair and alteration programs in the locations listed in this notice. It is the intention of GSA to award a multiple contractor, Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract. Description of Services: The contractor shall act as general contractor for small repair and alteration of real property in federal buildings (NAICS 236220), of both interior space and exterior building envelope and grounds. The contractor�s roles and responsibilities may include: design, demolition, abatement, repair and alteration of interior space including but not limited to, carpentry, woods and plastics, drywall, insulation, doors and openings, finishes, paint, bathroom fixtures, plumbing, HVAC, electrical, fire/life/safety equipment, specialized security equipment, fencing, windows, outdoor lighting. Value-added services such as service recommendations, additional coordination, and liaison with third parties may be required. The construction services will be performed in, but not limited to, federally owned facilities throughout Alaska. Task orders may occasionally require construction activities in privately owned leased facilities, however it is anticipated that the majority of construction will take place in federally owned facilities. The Government is considering structuring the IDIQ contracts to provide order-level flexibility for task orders to be placed that are either commercial or non-commercial. The construction services shall comply with GSA�s Core Building Standards, as well as all applicable engineering, architectural and construction standards and codes, to be fully described in any resulting solicitation. Inclusions: The work requirements will include design-build work and construction services as defined in RFO Part 2 and Part 36. The work requirements include Construction Wage Rate Act [formerly Davis-Bacon Act]. Commercial contracting approaches from RFO Part 12 will also be implemented. Exclusions: This Sources Sought does not include stand-alone architect-engineer (A-E) services as defined in the Brooks Act and RFO (FAR) Parts 2 and 36; however, some may require the contractor to provide design services in addition to construction services. This Sources Sought does not include construction management services of other separate projects. If interested in responding to this Sources Sought, please respond by completing and submitting the GSA Alaska Construction IDIQ Sources Sought Questionnaire no later than 1:00pm Pacific Time on Thursday, November 19th, 2026. NO TELEPHONE CALLS WILL BE ACCEPTED. QUESTIONS ARE NOT PERMITTED. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL OR SOLICITATION.

title: Request For Proposal (RFP) for NASA Agency-wide Supply of Liquid and Gaseous Helium
description: UPDATE 10/20/2026 The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) John F. Kennedy Space Center is pleased to release the 2027 NASA Agency-wide Supply of Liquid and Gaseous Helium opt-in opportunity as described in the original Helium Request for Proposal (RFP), Sections 2.10, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in, and 2.10.1, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in After Award. The Helium RFP was issued on December 21, 2024, and the original solicitation (as revised) remains open throughout the ordering period through the use of innovative provisions as prescribed in Section 2.10.1, IDIQ CLIN Pool Opt-in After Award. The Helium contract's ordering period remains valid through September 30, 2030. The RFP has resulted in the award of four fixed-price indefinite delivery (ID) requirements contracts to supply liquid and gaseous helium in support of operations at agency centers and facilities across the United States. Awards were made to the following companies: Airgas USA LLC (South), Airgas USA LLC (West), Linde, Inc., and Messer LLC. Each year during the life of the solicitation and at the time established via synopsis, the Government will accept proposals from new entrants for each IDIQ subCLIN location and the Government will also accept proposals from existing helium contractors for each additional IDIQ subCLIN location. A new entrant is a company that does not currently hold a NASA liquid and gaseous helium contract. The Government will evaluate the proposals to determine technical acceptability for a specific NASA location. Upon the Government's determination of technical acceptability, a contract (for new entrants) or contract modification (for existing helium Contractors) will be executed to add the Contractor to the IDIQ CLIN Pool for the specific NASA location. Thereafter, the Contractor will be eligible to participate in the IDIQ CLIN Pool process described in Section 2.10 for the NASA locations awarded to that Contractor. All eligible Contractors who are awarded an IDIQ subCLIN for a particular NASA location will have the option to compete for requirements within those IDIQ subCLINs which they are awarded. description: Project Title: Tactical Communication Systems Procurement, Services & Sustainment (TCS-PSS) Reference Number: CSO-ARMY-TCS-PSS-2027 Primary NAICS: 334220 � Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing 1. Opportunity Overview The Department of the Army, representing the Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN), the Project Manager Command and Control Transport (PM C2T), and the Product Manager Tactical Communication Systems (PdM TCS), has issued a Call for Solutions (CFS) under Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) Part 212.70 to establish a 10-year enterprise acquisition framework for innovative tactical communication capabilities. This initiative seeks to secure a mix of single-award Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts and/or Other Transactions (OTs) to streamline the procurement, testing, fielding, and lifecycle sustainment of both legacy systems and emerging transport hardware and software. Focused on supporting Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2), the effort aims to deliver highly secure�National Security Agency (NSA) High Assurance certified or Sensitive but Unclassified - Encrypted (SBU-E) qualified�resilient, and interoperable communication systems. To counter future cryptographic threats, the framework is seeking capable vendors to provide a plan for incorporating Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) compliant algorithms and achieving National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) validation by 31 December 2030, ensuring robust data protection and mission command resilience in contested joint and coalition environments. 2. title: Request for Information (RFI): Advanced Battery Circularity & Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR)
description: The Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) is conducting market research to assess the defense industrial base's capabilities and readiness regarding end-of-life battery recovery, reclamation, and critical mineral recycling. As the Department of Defense (DoD) executive agent for hazardous waste disposal and combat logistics, DLA must evaluate how new Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) universal waste regulations and Federal Executive Orders (including EO 14057 and EO 14110) impact the storage, transportation, processing, and domestic reclamation of military-grade and commercial batteries. Please provide direct, concise responses to the attached set of questions. The responses can be emailed directly to the POC for this RFI or uploaded to SAM prior to the closure of this RFI. If you have any further questions or need additional information please contact the POC for this RFI. This is a Request for Information (RFI) for planning and market research purposes only. It does not constitute a solicitation or a promise to issue a solicitation in the future.

title: Germany – Installation of doors and windows and related components – Eibenkamp 1 - Tragwerk und Gebäudehülle BIM
description: SBH | Schulbau Hamburg hat als Landesbetrieb der Freien und Hansestadt Hamburg (nachstehend SBH genannt) die Aufgabe, die Schulimmobilien unter Berücksichtigung der schulischen Belange nach wirtschaftlichen Grundsätzen zu planen, zu bauen, zu unterhalten und zu bewirtschaften und die mehr als 400 Schulen an die Behörde für Schule und Berufsbildung (BSB) zu vermieten. --------------- Auf dem Grundstück Eibenkamp 1, 22559 Hamburg errichtet Schulbau Hamburg für die Stadtteilschule und das Gymnasium Rissen ein gemeinsames Oberstufenhaus. Das Gebäude soll aufgrund seiner Lage am Landschaftsschutzgebet als nachhaltig innovativer Holzbau mit offenen Lernflächen, Gemeinschaftsflächen und einer Einfeld-Sporthalle realisiert werden. Das Gebäude fällt in die Gebäudeklasse 3 nach HBauO. Eine Baugenehmigung (Zustimmung) liegt vor. Die bautechnischen Nachweise zu Wärmeschutz, Schallschutz und Brandschutz werden für die Angebotsphase zur Verfügung gestellt. Der Standsicherheitsnachweis befindet sich in Prüfung. Es gelten die Anforderungen der LBBau in der Fassung von 2023. Die Planung des Gebäudes erfolgte nach der BIM-Methode. Das Baufeld ist bereits komplett geräumt, frei von Kampfmitteln und gemäß den gesetzlichen Anforderungen zum Schutz von Flora und Fauna hergerichtet. Die Gründung des Neubaus erfolgt als Flachgründung mit einer 35 cm dicken Stahlbeton-Sohlplatte und einer umlaufenden Fundamentverdickung. Das konstruktive Prinzip sieht für das Gebäude ein Holz-Skelett-Tragwerk mit aussteifenden BSP-Massivholz-Wandscheiben vor. Die Geschossdecken werden als Holzbetonverbunddecke und als BSP-Massivholzdecke, in Teilbereichen als Rippendecke ausgeführt. Dachdecken werden als weit gespannte Hohldecke über der Sporthalle und als BSP-Massivholzdecke oder Rippendecke konstruiert. Außenliegende Rettungsbalkone werden als StB-Fertigteilplatten mit Stahlstützen geplant. Auf dem extensiven Gründach soll eine PV-Anlage durch einen Drittanbieter errichtet werden. Die opaken Außenwände erhalten eine vorgehängte hinterlüftete Verkleidung aus Faserzement-Fassadenplatten mit sichtbarer Befestigung. Die Fenster werden als Holz-Alu-Elemente ausgeführt mit integrierten Außentüren auf die Rettungsbalkone und integrierten Lüftungsgittern. Außentüren an Haupt- und Nebeneingängen sind als Stahl-Rohrrahmentüren mit Glasfüllung geplant. --------------- Hier: Tragwerk und Gebäudehülle --------------- - Baustelleneinrichtung - Erdarbeiten - Stahlbetonbauarbeiten - Holzbau - Laubengänge - Dach - Fassade - Fenster - Metallbau Hinweis: Beim Vergabeverfahren für Tragwerk und Gebäudehülle des Neubaus ist die Einreichung von Nebenangeboten in Verbindung mit dem Hauptangebot möglich. Nebenangebote sind nur in den Bereichen des LV möglich, wo dies nicht durch die folgende Formulierung „(kein Nebenangebot möglich)“ ausgeschlossen ist. Nebenangebote in den Bereichen, in denen diese nicht zugelassen sind, stellen unzulässige Änderungen an den Vergabeunterlagen dar und führen zwingend zum Ausschluss. Nebenangebote sind auf einer besonderen Anlage anzugeben und deutlich zu kennzeichnen. Werden Nebenangebote nicht auf besonderer Anlage angegeben und deutlich gekennzeichnet, führt dieser Verstoß gegen § 13 EU Abs. 3 Satz 2 VOB/A zwingend zum Ausschluss.
